what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Brunei in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 170 Bruneian asylum seekers, and Australia hosted 100.0% of them.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Brunei, so it does not say why people left.
The main year of displacement in the data is 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2015 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
